name: sidon_enhance
doc: Restore/denoise samples with Sidon v0.1 speech restoration (output 48kHz). Cleans noisy winners before final scoring/delivery. Returns NEW sample_ids (originals kept); re-score the new samples.

name: audio_stretch
doc: Time-stretch samples WITHOUT pitch change (audiostretchy). ratio 0.25-4.0 (>1 = slower/longer). For pacing/dramatic-tempo experiments. Returns NEW sample_ids; re-score them.
